Eve of Destruction Remaster
Windows x64
https://github.com/catsandsoup/eod-recomp

GET STARTED
Unzip the download and open eod.exe. Choose your North American PS2 game
ISO when asked. If you already extracted your disc, choose SLUS_209.10
inside that folder. The game remembers the library for future releases.
To change the saved location, open eodsetup.exe and choose Game data.

UPDATING
Close the game, unzip the new release into a fresh folder, and start that
folder's eod.exe. eodsetup.exe opens the settings utility. Press F1 in
the running game and check the version in the remaster menu header
against the release you downloaded. If a shortcut opens the old version,
point it at the new eod.exe.

CONTROLS
Xbox and PlayStation controllers are supported. Start + Select opens the
remaster menu; use the D-pad to navigate, shoulder buttons to change tabs,
A/Cross to select, and B/Circle to go back. F1 opens the menu by keyboard.

ONLINE
Host a lobby and share the Garage Code, join by code, or choose a LAN game.
The host selects the event and shared rules. Each driver chooses a car
and paint. Guests mark Ready, then the host selects Start Event.
End Race returns the party to the lobby. Close Lobby ends the session.
The remaster menu stays live during an online race.

AUDIO
Settings > Audio has separate Master, Music and Incoming Voice Volume controls.
Incoming voice defaults to 100% and can be adjusted from 0% to 200%. By
default the game gets quieter while someone speaks. Turn off Lower Game
During Speech to keep a fixed game level. Both preferences are also in
Online > Voice when connected. Microphone transmission starts off. Mute
Others silences incoming speech and Deafen also switches off transmission.

SETTINGS
Change graphics, controls, mods and audio in the remaster menu.
eodsetup.exe also provides Windows setup and save-import tools.

Bring your own North American PS2 copy (SLUS_209.10 v1.00).
No game data is included.

Report problems: https://github.com/catsandsoup/eod-recomp/issues
Credits and licences: https://github.com/catsandsoup/eod-recomp#legal-credits-and-licences
